summary: Frontend-only testing of Sub-categories and Product Video Links features. ALL 14 FEATURES TESTED AND WORKING CORRECTLY. App runs in MOCK MODE with all APIs intercepted by mockAdapter.js.
passed_tests: Storefront grouped view shows sub-category chips under Electronics (Headphones, Smartphones, Wearables) - subcats-cat-1 with subcat-chip-cat-7/8/9
Storefront grouped view shows sub-category chips under Fashion (Shoes, Bags, Accessories) - subcats-cat-2 with subcat-chip-cat-10/11/12
Clicking a sub-category chip filters products (shows 'no products' as expected since mock data assigns to parent categories)
Category dropdown filter shows parent categories with sub-categories indented with └ symbol
Product detail view (prod-1) shows Video Grid section with 2-column layout (product-video-grid)
Video grid embeds YouTube videos as iframes (product-video-0, product-video-1, product-video-2)
TikTok embed shows 'Video currently unavailable' - expected for mock URLs
Product detail for prod-4 shows video grid with 2 videos
Product detail for prod-2 has no video grid (empty video_links) - correctly hidden
Dashboard Categories tab shows parent categories with sub-categories nested underneath (dashed border, indented) - sub-cat-cat-7 through sub-cat-cat-12
Dashboard Category modal has Parent Category dropdown (category-parent-select) showing all root categories
Dashboard Product modal shows video links section with Add Video button (add-video-link-btn)
Maximum 4 video links enforced in product modal (shows 'Tối đa 4 video' text)
Category page (/shop/the-elite-shop/categories) shows sub-category chips under each parent (Headphones, Smartphones, Wearables under Electronics; Shoes, Bags, Accessories under Fashion)
critical_code_review_comments: All sub-category and video links features implemented correctly
Sub-category chips use data-testid format: subcat-chip-cat-{id}
Video grid uses 2-column layout with grid-cols-2 class
Parent category dropdown in category modal correctly shows 'Không có (Danh mục gốc)' for no parent option
Video links section shows 'Thêm tối đa 4 liên kết video (YouTube, TikTok)' description
seed_data_creation: None - using existing mock data with 12 categories (6 root + 6 sub) and products with video_links (prod-1 has 3, prod-4 has 2)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sub-categories and video links features fully tested. Key test IDs: subcats-cat-1/2, subcat-chip-cat-7/8/9/10/11/12, product-video-grid, product-video-0/1/2, category-parent-select, add-video-link-btn, product-video-link-0/1/2/3, sub-cat-cat-7 through sub-cat-cat-12. Mock data has products assigned to parent categories (cat-1, cat-2) not sub-categories, so filtering by sub-category shows 'no products' - this is expected data behavior, not a bug.
